From: Julia Khan <julia.khan@gmail.com>

Subject: Re: Julia Khan - onsite confirmation (11:00 AM PDT) + quick note

Hi Irene —

I’m so sorry to do this last minute: my flight from SFO has been delayed due to a mechanical issue and the airline just rebooked me on a later flight. I’m now estimating a 2.5–3 hour delay; I won’t make the 11:00 loop.

I understand this is short notice. If possible, I’m available for a same‑day evening slot (after 5:00 PM PDT) or anytime tomorrow morning. I can also do a phone screen for the first slot and join the system design afterwards if that helps.

Also — I’ll keep the panel updated as I get firm timing.

Really appreciate your flexibility.
Julia
Candidate — Julia Khan

Team —

Julia just updated that she’s delayed ~2.5–3 hours and won’t make the 11:00 slot. Primary asks:
- Who can shift to an evening slot today (available after 5:00 PM PDT)?
- If evening doesn’t work, do we want to push to tomorrow morning at 9:00 AM PDT?
- If split is preferable, we can do HM + coding tonight and system design tomorrow.

Please reply with a single line: “Tonight 5:30 OK” or “Prefer tomorrow 9:00” so we can confirm quickly. If you’re out, just say “OOTO.”

Irene

From: Julia Khan <julia.khan@gmail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Julia Khan - urgent: travel delay & same‑day options

Hi all —

I hate to follow up with more bad news: I tested positive for COVID this evening after a rapid antigen taken in the SFO terminal. Out of an abundance of caution I need to cancel the onsite loop entirely. I’m really disappointed — I was looking forward to meeting the team.

Can we please:
- Pause today’s scheduling and move to next week (any day the week of Apr 26th would work)
- I’d also like guidance for expense reimbursement for my last‑minute cancelled hotel and the taxi; I’ve attached the boarding pass and receipt to this email (inline in candidate reply).

Happy to provide the photo of the test result. Please let me know next steps and whether you’d like to keep my interview active.

Apologies again and thanks for understanding,
Julia Khan
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Khan <julia.khan@gmail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Julia Khan - urgent: travel delay & same‑day options

Hi Julia —

Thanks for the update and I’m sorry to hear you’re unwell. Please rest and get better — we appreciate you letting us know quickly.

Next steps from our side:
- We’ll pause the loop and I’ve noted we should look at availability the week of Apr 26. Can you share 2–3 windows that week (AM/PM) and we’ll coordinate?
- For expenses: Monica from Talent Ops (cc’d) will follow up with our reimbursement form and the next steps. Monica — can you confirm receipt of the boarding pass/receipt and the expected timeline for reimbursement?
- If you’re comfortable sharing a photo of the positive antigen, send it to me or Monica and we’ll add it to the candidate record for compliance.

We’d very much like to keep your interview active — the team is still interested; timing is the only constraint. Wishing you a quick recovery.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Recruiting Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: expense-form.pdf
